title: Celebrate the Artistry of ‘Wonder Man’ with Sir Ben Kingsley and Destin Daniel Cretton at IndieWire and Disney’s Pass the Remote
summary: The event, which takes place at Vidiots Foundation on June 10, celebrates the talent behind one of Marvel's most innovative shows.

title: Celebrate the Art of Casting at IndieWire and Disney’s Pass the Remote Panel
summary: Casting directors of five of our favorite shows will join IndieWire's Jim Hemphill for a conversation at Vidiots on Monday, June 8.

summary: The underrated Adam Carter Rehmeier uses his strong facility with actors to help make the archetypal seem fresh and exciting.

title: Hollywood Needs Creators More Than They Need It
summary: "Backrooms" and "Obsession" are likely to kick off a rush of studios trying to sign prominent creators, but artists should be wary of what the system is really offering.

title: Kerry Washington Looks Back at ‘Django Unchained,’ Why It ‘Terrified’ Her, and the Scene Tarantino Kept Canceling
summary: Washington appeared at a New Beverly Cinema midnight screening to discuss her work on Quentin Tarantino's Western and how it informed her career, including her current work on Apple's "Imperfect Women."

title: Even Martin Scorsese Is Using AI… but Only for Storyboarding

summary: Nicholas Galitzine is a cosmically swole himbo in a movie about how having a big heart is more important than having big muscles, but also that having really big muscles is the most important thing of all.

title: ‘The Easy Kind’ Review: Country Renegade Elizabeth Cook Plays a Fictionalized Take on Herself in Slice of Life Drama
summary: The long-time country singer, songwriter, and radio host melds fact and fiction in Katy Chevigny's (mostly true, but not totally) Nashville drama.

title: ‘The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins’ Creators Explain What Makes Erika Alexander a ‘Legend’

title: Don’t Tell ‘The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins’ Star Erika Alexander to ‘Stay in Your Lane’
summary: IndieWire Honors: The sitcom veteran, who receives the Maverick Award for her grand return to NBC, says, "No, I'm an off-road vehicle."
